claims.statement: npm run build builds the Windows managed helper on win32-x64, runs tsup to emit out/main, out/preload and out/agent-host, then Vite to emit out/renderer; package.json main is out/main/main.js (scripts/build.mjs, build-main.mjs).
npm test runs node --test src/**/*.test.mjs with a default 120s per-test timeout (PI_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS overrides) and asserts a clean exit status (test-runner.mjs).

scripts/verify.mjs is a single release gate that runs format, lint, typecheck, dependency contract, unit tests, managed-process workflows/flood, contract, Pi 0.84 compat, toolchain/catalog, i18n, security, build, artifact isolation, smoke, and browser tests in order, failing on the first error.

scripts/package-desktop.mjs prepares bundled tools and runs verify.mjs before invoking electron-builder (--dir for pack, --publish never for release) and enforces the unsigned-Beta trust status on Windows.

electron-builder.yml packages a pure ASAR app and ships signed toolchain catalogs and the current target's core tools as extraResources, restoring Pi authoring docs/examples via explicit FileSets; targets are dmg+zip (macOS), nsis (Windows), and AppImage (Linux).
The Windows NSIS artifact is named Pi-Agent-Desktop-Unsigned-Beta-Setup and CI enforces it stays NotSigned because Authenticode is not provisioned.

The native Windows helper is built by scripts/build-windows-managed-helper.mjs, verified reproducible by verify-windows-helper-reproducibility.mjs, and CI runs cargo audit and cargo deny --locked against the pinned Cargo.lock.

.github/workflows/build-desktop.yml runs a test-platforms matrix (Linux x64, macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64), pins Node 22 and (on Windows) a 1.96.1 Rust toolchain, then builds, signs/notarizes macOS, packages the Windows unsigned-Beta installer and Linux AppImage.
